description: This file contains utility functions and classes for manipulating Python Abstract Syntax Trees (ASTs), including tree traversal, dumping, stripping, comparison, and a custom node visitor.

classes.name: NonExistent
classes.description: A placeholder class used to represent missing attributes in AST nodes.

classes.name: ExplicitNodeVisitor
classes.description: An extension of ast.NodeVisitor that removes implicit visit methods.

methods.name: iter_node
methods.description: Iterates over an AST node or list, yielding attribute name-value pairs.

methods.name: dump_tree
methods.description: Pretty-prints an AST or similar structure with indentation.

methods.name: strip_tree
methods.description: Removes all attributes not in _fields from an AST, canonicalizing trees for comparison.

methods.name: allow_ast_comparison
methods.description: Monkey-patches AST node classes to support equality and inequality comparisons.

methods.name: fast_compare
methods.description: Efficiently compares two AST trees for equality.
